title: Vermitteln: zwischen zwei Positionen
withheldReason: genuine CEFR B2 — chairing/moderating a formal multi-party discussion, above fide's B1 ceiling; seed for a future B2/advanced track.
why: Speaks to a Hausversammlung: presents both sides, proposes a compromise and argues it is bearable FOR BOTH, using required concessive markers. Sustained argumentation to a group.

title: Moderieren: eine Diskussion im Verein
withheldReason: genuine CEFR B2 — chairing/moderating a formal multi-party discussion, above fide's B1 ceiling; seed for a future B2/advanced track.
why: Chairs a club discussion: withholds own opinion, allocates the floor, closes by naming what stays unresolved. Institutional low-frequency Redemittel. B2 on function, register and discourse markers at once.

title: Vermitteln: Streit um die Waschküche
why: Neighbour dispute over the laundry rota. Concrete, familiar, high-frequency lexis; the only above-B1 demand is the neutral-mediator frame, which fide does not test.

title: Vermitteln: Streit um den Veloraum
why: Bike-room overcrowding with mutual accusation. Everyday register throughout; mediator role alone does not carry a B2 claim.

title: Vermitteln: Streit um die Besucherparkplätze
why: Visitor-parking entitlement dispute. Concrete referent, everyday lexis; rule-vs-preference argument sits inside B1.

title: Vermitteln: Streit über Ruhezeiten am Wochenende
why: Weekend drilling vs quiet. Canonical B1 topic space with an obvious compromise axis.

title: Vermitteln: Streit über den gemeinsamen Garten
why: Shared garden, vegetables vs lawn. Two compatible concrete wants with a physical resolution; least demanding of the set.

title: Vermitteln: Streit über die Lautstärke im Treppenhaus
why: Children loud in the stairwell. One mild appeal-to-principle against one concrete complaint; everyday lexis.

title: Vermitteln: Streit über die Nutzung des Trockenraums
why: Drying room monopolised. Concrete resource scheduling; the solution shape is named in the criteria.

title: Vermitteln: Streit über den Lärm auf dem Spielplatz
why: Playground noise, families vs teenagers vs residents. Semi-public and multi-party, but concrete and immediate.

title: Vermitteln: Streit über die Grillnutzung im Hof
why: Courtyard grill, smoke and frequency. Sensory, high-frequency lexis, direct compromise axis.

title: Vermitteln: Streit über die Haustierhaltung im Haus
why: Barking dog vs quiet. One side argues from a value claim; that is the single above-B1 element.

title: Vermitteln: Streit über die Reinigung des Treppenhauses
why: Stairwell cleaning rota fairness. Near-duplicate of the laundry-rota item, same solution shape.

title: Vermitteln: Streit über die Temperatur im Büro
why: Office window, too warm vs too cold. Bodily-comfort preference clash with a mechanical compromise.

title: Vermitteln: Streit über Kinderwagen im Hausflur
why: Prams in the hallway, storage need vs emergency-access safety. One position is a norm/safety argument, so the two sides carry different weight.

title: Vermitteln: Streit über die gemeinsame Küche
why: Shared flat kitchen, too-little-time excuse and its rejection. Candidate reformulates a justification AND its rebuttal.

title: Vermitteln: Streit über den Gemeinschaftsraum
why: Common room over-booked for birthdays. Allocation fairness with a named procedural fix (booking system).

title: Vermitteln: Streit über das Rauchen auf dem Balkon
why: Balcony smoking vs a small child upstairs. Competing ENTITLEMENTS (property/autonomy vs health), not competing preferences — reformulating that fairly without adjudicating is real upper-B1 work.

title: Vermitteln: Streit über die Lautstärke der Musik
why: Evening music volume, young resident vs older couple. Preference clash with a token norm-appeal.

title: Vermitteln: Streit über die gemeinsame Waschmaschine
why: Shared washing machine, contested blame for the damage. The parties disagree about a FACT, so a contested accusation must be restated neutrally — harder than restating two wants.
